questions: Section 10 rates scuba on depth alone and section 15 allows an exclusion rider. For a ratable recreational scuba avocation, is the house practice to charge the section 10 depth debits, or to write an exclusion rider naming the diving hazard?
If an exclusion rider naming the diving hazard is written on a file, do the section 10 avocation debits come out of the debit total, or do the rider and the debits both stand?

The section 10 scuba table reads on maximum depth only. Does the office adjust that charge for dive frequency or dive type - say 12 dives a year, open water only, no cave or wreck - or is maximum depth the only input?

Section 16 sends combinations of cardiac risk factors to underwriting judgement. Where each factor is individually non-ratable - an A1c in the 5.7 to 6.4 range, an untreated systolic in the 130s, a BMI in the mid-20s, and tobacco quit inside 5 years - does the office add debits for the cluster, and if so how many?
